_about: Allowlist of meme formats a deck may use. Edit freely: ids are memegen.link template ids (https://api.memegen.link/templates), lines is how many captions the format takes, use tells the model when the format fits. Cartoon and animal formats only, on purpose: no real people's faces on a teacher's slide.

formats.use: a plain way vs a smarter way (top: weak habit, bottom: better habit)
two things that are really the same, or two sides pointing at each other
calmly ignoring a problem that is clearly growing (top: setup, bottom: the calm line)
an idea that shows up everywhere (top: X, bottom: X everywhere)
a thought-provoking question that makes students stop and think
mocking a common wrong claim (top: the claim, bottom: same claim in mocking case)
a plan whose last step reveals a flaw (steps 1-2 sensible, 3-4 the same surprising result)
unmasking: what looks like X is really Y (villain, prompt, unmasked, reaction)
misidentifying a concept (person, the thing, 'Is this X?')
swerving to the tempting option (option A, option B, the one chosen)
a hard choice between two options (option 1, option 2, the struggling person)
an over-enthusiastic rule (top: X, bottom: all the Y)
an excited, simple reaction to a satisfying idea
an unimpressed reaction to a common mistake
